description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_TravelBooking" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/travel-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SearchRequest" name="Ticket search request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_SelectionProvided" name="Route, date and time selected"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_PersonalPaymentProvided" name="Personal and payment details provided"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_TicketDelivery" name="Ticket delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ReminderInstructions" name="Reminder and check-in instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_FeedbackProvided" name="Post-travel feedback provided"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TravelBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel Company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SearchRequest" name="Search request" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Selection" name="Route, date and time" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_SelectionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PersonalPayment" name="Personal and payment details" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_DetailsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket" name="Ticket" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTicket" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminders" name="Reminders and instructions" sourceRef="SendTask_SendReminders" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_ReminderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Post-travel feedback" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_FeedbackReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer Journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CustomerBegins" name="Customer begins booking">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for flight, train or bus ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select route, date and time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived" name="Ticket received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_TicketReceived" messageRef="Msg_TicketDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_ReminderReceived" name="Reminders and instructions received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C6</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ReminderReceived" messageRef="Msg_ReminderInstructions"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustFeedback_Split" name="Post-travel feedback or services?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide post-travel feedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustFeedback_Merge" name="Customer part concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_C11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerDone" name="Customer part concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_C11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CustomerBegins" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_TicketReceived" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_ReminderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_ReminderReceived" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_CustFeedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Gateway_CustFeedback_Split" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustFeedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Gateway_CustFeedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_CustFeedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Gateway_CustFeedback_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel Ticket Booking" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SearchReceived" name="Ticket search request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SearchReceived" messageRef="Msg_SearchRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_SelectionReceived" name="Route, date and time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T2</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_SelectionReceived" messageRef="Msg_SelectionProvided"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_DetailsReceived" name="Personal and payment details received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DetailsReceived" messageRef="Msg_PersonalPaymentProvided"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" name="Split ticket dispatch and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTicket" name="Send ticket via email or SMS" messageRef="Msg_TicketDelivery">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" name="Update seat inventory">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" name="Join ticket dispatch and inventory update">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendReminders" name="Send reminders and check-in or boarding instructions" messageRef="Msg_ReminderInstructions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted" name="Journey completed received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_JourneyCompleted" messageRef="Msg_JourneyCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Post-travel feedback or services?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_FeedbackReceived" name="Post-travel feedback received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackReceived" messageRef="Msg_FeedbackProvided"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" name="Process concludes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_T15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Booking process concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_T15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SearchReceived" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_SelectionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T2" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_SelectionReceived" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_DetailsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T3" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_DetailsReceived" targetRef="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T4" sourceRef="ServiceTask_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T5" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="SendTask_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T6" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T7" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T8" sourceRef="Task_UpdateSeatInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T9" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" targetRef="SendTask_SendReminders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T10" sourceRef="SendTask_SendReminders" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T11" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_JourneyCompleted" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T12" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_FeedbackReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T13" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_FeedbackReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T14" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_T15" sourceRef="Gateway_Feedback_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
